title: Go: gRPC Client and Server
description: Simulate a gRPC client/server system with service definition, request/response handling, streaming, and error handling.

steps.title: Define the service (simulated proto)
steps.description: Define Go structs to simulate a protobuf service: `UserService` with `GetUser(id int32) (*User, error)` and `User{ID int32, Name string, Email string}`. Print the service definition using `fmt.Printf("Service: %s\n", "UserService")`.
hints: Simulate proto without actual protobuf compiler
Use int32 to match proto int32 type

verification.failureMessage: Print the service name and its methods.

steps.title: Implement the server
steps.description: Create a `server` struct that implements the `UserService` interface. Use an in-memory `map[int32]*User` as storage. Implement `GetUser(ctx context.Context, req *GetUserRequest) (*GetUserResponse, error)`. Print each request using `fmt.Printf("GetUser: %d\n", req.ID)`.
hints: The server struct embeds unimplementedServer pattern
Use sync.RWMutex to protect the map
Return error for not found with status.Error(codes.NotFound, ...)

verification.failureMessage: Print each GetUser request with the requested ID.

steps.title: Implement the client
steps.description: Create a `client` struct with a `server` reference (simulated in-process). It calls `server.GetUser` directly and prints the response using `fmt.Printf("User: %+v\n", user)`. Add connection simulation (just print `"dialed"` and `"closed"`).
hints: Simulate in-process without real gRPC dial
Client wraps the same UserService interface

verification.failureMessage: Print connection lifecycle and user response.

steps.title: Server-streaming response
steps.description: Add `ListUsers(ctx context.Context, req *ListUsersRequest, stream UserService_ListUsersServer) error`. Simulate streaming by sending multiple users one at a time through a channel. Print each streamed user using `fmt.Printf("Stream: %s\n", user.Name)`.
hints: Streaming server sends multiple responses per request
Use a mock stream type with a Send method
Send returns error if client cancels

steps.title: Client-streaming request
steps.description: Add `CreateUsers(ctx context.Context, stream UserService_CreateUsersServer) error`. Read users from a mock stream (slice), insert each into storage, and return a summary response with the count. Print each received user using `fmt.Printf("Created: %s\n", user.Name)`.
hints: Client streaming reads multiple messages from one request
Use mock stream with a Recv method
Accumulate results and send single response

verification.failureMessage: Print each created user and the summary.

steps.title: Error handling and deadlines
steps.description: Add deadline handling by checking context cancellation (`ctx.Err()`) in streaming handlers. Return proper errors: `codes.NotFound`, `codes.DeadlineExceeded`, `codes.Internal`. Print error types and messages using `fmt.Printf("Error [%v]: %s\n", code, message)`.

verification.failureMessage: Print gRPC error codes and messages.
